correctness.rationale: PASS: For G=K_N minus a spanning disjoint cycle union H, F=J+B over F_(2^h) with B=I+A_H and BJ=JB=J. On each C_n, B is multiplication by x^(-1)(x²+x+1) modulo x^n-1. The root-order-three test gives 2min(t,2^nu2(n)) nullity exactly when 3|n, otherwise zero. If N even then J²=0 and F=B(I+J) commutes with the invertible I+J, preserving B^t kernels. If N odd, decompose into the ones line and sum-zero hyperplane: F kills the ones line and acts as B on sum-zero, and ker B^t already lies in sum-zero for t≥1, producing precisely ε1_(t≥1). Finite-dimensional Fitting decomposition gives periodic states as the invertible component, exactly q^(N-d) states, and first-entry count q^(N-d+dim ker F^t); the maximum K is attained when positive. For H=C_(3·2^s)⊔C_(3·2^s), d=4·2^s, K=2^s=N/6; the last-layer gap in kernel dimension is four, so probability 1-q^(-4), while density=1-2/(N-1) and graph diameter two for s≥1. Complete assigned proof and both source verifiers examined, ten exact blob identities and two Git trees reconstructed and matched. Independently written GF2 power-rank check over 232 graph multisets, exhaustive orbit checks over eleven small families, explicit s=1..4 dense examples, and exhaustive GF4 state checks over four cases passed. Finite checks are corroboration; unbounded quantifiers rest on the algebra above. Result does not classify eventual primitive periods or individual cycle basins.

evidence: For every linear transformation over a finite field, Fitting theory says the periodic subset is the stable invertible image, and the numbers entering by t depend on dim ker F^t. This general framework is credited, not claimed new.

Ciandrini et al. arXiv:0809.1526v3 Sections II–III give general matrix-kernel/attractor relations for XOR network dynamics and discuss feedback-loop topologies; they do not provide the explicit dense-complement graph-family power ranks.

Kantic et al. arXiv:2604.01548v1 give general algorithms and a tree-height formula on cyclic finite modules, not the J-coupled complement-of-2-factor rank theorem.

None of the inspected broader theorems states or directly implies the closed all-cycle-size rank-one J correction and its exact sharp high-density transient distribution without significant additional graph-specific calculation. No claimed algorithmic complexity improvement.

value.rationale: PASS: The complement of a spanning 2-factor is a natural (N-3)-regular dense graph family, and time to first periodicity is a natural exact invariant of finite-field neighbor-sum dynamics. The theorem classifies all initial-state transient layers for arbitrary numbers and lengths of removed cycles, identifies the precise cubic-root/two-adic resonance and global parity correction, and shows a vanishing deleted-edge proportion produces a linear N/6 preperiod for 1-q^(-4) of all initial configurations, despite the even-order complete graph being immediately periodic. This is a nontrivial graph-family structural benchmark and a sharp density-only heuristic counterexample, not merely a tiny table, renamed parameter, or textbook deduction. It does not claim a universal graph theorem or primitive-cycle classification.

final_claim: For H=⊔ C_(n_i), n_i≥3, G=K_N\E(H), and synchronous loopless finite-field characteristic-two neighbor sum F, put e_i=2^ν₂(n_i) when 3|n_i else 0, ε=N mod 2, d=ε+2Σe_i, K=max(ε,e_i). Then for every t≥0 dim ker F^t=ε·1_(t≥1)+2Σmin(t,e_i); number of states first periodic by time t is q^(N-d+dim ker F^t), precisely q^(N-d) are initially periodic, and maximal preperiod K is attained if K>0. Removing two cycles C_(3·2^s), s≥1, gives N=6·2^s, K=N/6 and P(T=K)=1-q^(-4), at graph density 1-2/(N-1), diameter two. Primitive eventual periods and individual basins are outside scope.
limitations: Only finite characteristic-two fields and simple undirected complements of spanning ordinary disjoint cycles, synchronously updated without self or affine term.
Exact first-periodic-entry population, not the number of eventual primitive cycles of each length or individual basin sizes.
Verified finite calculations are not proofs of unbounded cycle lengths, numbers of components, or finite field extension degrees.
Novelty remains qualified historical-priority assessment; the local cyclic polynomial factorization and generic finite-dimensional Fitting law are known.
Scientific assessment complete; publication not_ready until metadata and AUDIT.json private provenance is removed in fully guarded replacements.
